How to use this simulator
  1. Choose a workbook activity and inspect the picture.
  2. Predict what will happen and change one input.
  3. Test your rule, then record what you observed.

This browser model demonstrates workbook logic with simulated inputs. Each watering dose is shown for 60 seconds in the simulator. The workbook’s physical pump pulse is 0.5 seconds. Cooldown is accelerated.
